description: This file contains implementation details for generating real (floating-point) numbers from bit patterns, used internally by the Abseil random number distributions.

classes.name: GeneratePositiveTag
classes.description: Tag type controlling generation of positive real numbers.

classes.name: GenerateNegativeTag
classes.description: Tag type controlling generation of negative real numbers.

classes.name: GenerateSignedTag
classes.description: Tag type controlling generation of signed real numbers.

methods.name: GenerateRealFromBits
methods.description: Generates a floating-point real number from a 64-bit pattern, with control over sign, range, and zero inclusion.
